results.title: Home loads with title, CTA and the 3D ambient world (or its fallback)
Every navigation link leads to a working screen with an active state
Zones are locked before a character exists, and play is refused
Zone 1: full playable scenario with consequences, feedback and debrief
Progress persists across refresh; Zone 2 unlocks; replay works and keeps best
Zones 2–4 are playable, unlock in order, and carry earlier decisions forward
Progress page shows XP, achievements, journal and evidence
Settings: text size, 3D off fallback, and reset with confirmation
Mobile (375×740): no horizontal overflow, working menu, playable scenario
Without WebGL, the game falls back to a flat background and still works
No console errors or uncaught exceptions
